primary.time_standard: NASA POWER source LST; not Europe/London civil time or verified UTC

S0: Exact repaired Draft2 step; RE, battery, on-demand DG, critical UPS; no DG charging
S1: Exact repaired Draft2 step with feasible DG surplus charging enabled; no simultaneous outer-interval charging/discharging
S2: SOC-reserve commitment: initiate when deficit cannot be supplied without crossing SOC 0.30 or SOC<=0.30; latch until RE covers all demand, or SOC>=0.60 and battery can cover deficit above reserve. Committed DG precedes battery; battery bridges startup/exhaustion. No DG charging.
S3: S2 plus feasible DG surplus charging
threshold_provenance: Illustrative controller assumptions, registered before outcomes, not OEM specifications or tuned optimum
unsupported: No ramp or extra startup fuel model
MDT-derived positive output below 25% not supported
sink: Draft2 assumed 25 kW AC dump load; no automatic upsizing
comparison: Same-start nested deterministic windows, independent initialisation; no Monte Carlo or independent weather samples
diagnostics: fixed-trajectory fuel recalculation before closed-loop comparison
24h synthetic DG-only 30kW/100L inventory for fuel exhaustion
single-interval 15kW minimum-load sensitivity with unchanged 25kW sink
